name: APBS
summary: Continuum electrostatics calculations for biomolecular systems.

argv: import shutil, subprocess; p=shutil.which('apbs'); assert p, 'apbs executable missing'; r=subprocess.run([p, '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True); assert r.returncode in (0, 13), r.stderr; assert 'apbs' in (r.stdout + r.stderr).lower(), 'APBS version output missing'; print((r.stdout + r.stderr).strip())

notes: The maintainer requests user registration before use; the installer does not register the user or submit structures to a web server.

The conda-forge feedstock documents APBS --version returning exit code 13; verification checks the executable's version output and allows that documented code without accepting other failures. This does not validate a Poisson-Boltzmann calculation or PQR input.
